tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is the default theme during a workout.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, sheets, the set confirmation card.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Subtle fills: inputs, chips, pressed states, skeleton loaders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on any surface. Weights, reps and titles.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, units, timestamps, the bar breakdown line. 4.5:1 on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Next Rep uses borders, not shadows, to separate surfaces.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand colour: primary actions, the mic button, links, active tab, focus rings. Use sparingly, at most one accent element per screen region.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on accent (e.g. the mic icon on the VoiceButton). 5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Personal records, 'All synced', confirmed sets. Always paired with an icon or label, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention but not an error: 'sets waiting to sync', the 'total or per side?' prompt. Use on surface-100 or surface-200 only.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions (delete set, sync failed). Similar lightness to success in light theme, so always pair with an icon or label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; between a number and its unit.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between list rows, screen side margins on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections within a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top and bottom breathing room on screens; generous whitespace is part of the brand.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable. Gym hands are sweaty; never go below this.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and circles: the VoiceButton, the SyncBadge, avatars.
